# Ticket lookup

### Requirement: Lookup at the counter
- NFR-020: Ticket lookup MUST be fast for up to 12 clerks, excluding archived tickets.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Acuse de devolución
- FR-101: El kiosco DEBE emitir un acuse rápido para una devolución interna.

## Requirements

FR-071: The sync icon MUST disappear as needed.

## Requisitos

FR-040: El aviso de entrega DEBE desaparecer cuando sea necesario.
Solo la supervisora puede cerrar el aviso manualmente.

## Requirements

FR-091: The kiosk MUST use the profile `fast` only for standard playlists.

## Requisitos

FR-010: La cola DEBE reaccionar rápido sin eliminar los trabajos pausados.

## Requirements

NFR-082: Gallery preview MUST load quickly within 350 ms.

- NFR-082 Measurement end: first preview paint.
